The Leibniz-Institut für Analytische Wissenschaften - ISAS - e. V. develops efficient analytical methods for health research. Thus, it contributes to the improvement of the prevention, early diagnosis, and therapy of diseases like cardiovascular diseases or cancer. Overall, the institute strives to advance precision medicine by combining knowledge from different fields such as biology, chemistry, computer science, medicine, pharmacology, and physics. ISAS is a member of the Leibniz Association and is publicly funded by the Federal Republic of Germany and its federal states.We invite applications for the Research Group Biofluorescence: PhD candidate (f/m/d)This project, funded by the DFG as part of CRC 1752, "DYNAMO: Immediate Tumor Dynamics in Melanoma Therapy“ (https://www.uni-due.de/crc1752/) seeks to combine high-resolution multi-omics profiling, advanced computational modeling, and clinically aligned biomarker stratification, in order to generate actionable, patient-specific predictions and resistance-targeting interventions in melanoma therapy. You will be responsible for finding out the role of neutrophils for the early development of therapy resistance in human melanoma. The project is being carried out in collaboration with University Hospital Essen and the University of Duisburg-Essen.You will be responsible for- Experimental setup and execution of neutrophil functional profiling in the context of melanoma immune regulation and immune checkpoint inhibitor (ICI) response- Functional assays of neutrophils including migration, phagocytosis, and ROS production- Optimization and standardization of neutrophil functional assays for primary human samples- Few-cell proteomics for deep molecular characterization of neutrophil subsets- Multicolor flow cytometry of PBMCs and immune cell populations- Live-cell imaging and advanced microscopy for dynamic immune cell behavior analysis- Planning and execution of stimulation and inhibition experiments to dissect signaling pathways regulating neutrophil function in the melanoma context- Data processing, analysis, interpretation, and visualization of experimental results in collaboration with computational partnersYour profile- Completed diploma or master’s degree in molecular biology, cancer biology, immunology, cell biology, bioinformatics, translational medicine or related disciplines- Experience in molecular and cellular biology techniques, ideally with hands-on experience with functional immune cell assays (preferably with neutrophils or myeloid cells) is an advantage- Strong interest in melanoma biology, tumor immunology, immune checkpoint therapy, translational cancer research, and tumor–immune interactions- Experience with cell culture, flow cytometry, microscopy, proteomics workflows or high-dimensional immune profiling approaches is desirable- Experience with bioinformatics or biostatistics is beneficial but not required- Ability to work independently and in interdisciplinary teams, with strong organizational skills and analytical thinking- High level of self-motivation, scientific curiosity, reliability, creativity, and team-oriented personality with enthusiasm to work in a collaborative research environment- Fluent in spoken and written EnglishWe offer- A clear research topic as well as multifold training and support for PhD students in framework of ISAS and the Leibniz association- Opportunities for scientific training and development in an international environment and an excellent working atmosphere in a very dynamic and professional team- Access to state-of-the-art technologies including few-cell proteomics, high-dimensional flow cytometry, and advanced microscopy platforms- Integration into an interdisciplinary, internationally visible, translation-oriented cancer immunology research network- The opportunity to present your data on international conferences and participate in workshops- A wide range of opportunities for further training and qualifications- Flexible working times, mobile working and attractive social benefits- Family-friendly infrastructure and support from a family serviceNon-residents who apply for this job will receive help from the institute to find accommodation and to handle authorities. Applications from disabled applicants are welcome. ISAS supports the principle of equal opportunity for all employees and therefore particularly encourages women to apply.The part-time position (65%) starts on October 1, 2026, and is offered until June 30, 2030. The salary will be according to the German TV-L and falls within the pay group 13. The time limitation of the contract is based on the Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz (WissZeitVG).ISAS collects and processes the personal data of its applicants in accordance with European and German legal regulations. Further information on data protection and the processing of personal data can be found at: https://www.isas.de/en/datenschutz.The closing date for applications is** August 14, 2026**. Please apply via our applicant portal (https://bewerbermanagement.net/en/jobposting/4e342c0b4ebdda805ec07aefc033c1e6bce0d9010/apply?ref=Agentur+f%C3%BCr+Arbeit+Dortmund) . If you have any questions (reference number 411_2026), feel free to contact the Human Resources team (bewerbungen@isas.de). Further information about the institute can be found at: https://www.isas.de/en.

jobs.occupation: AI-udvikler til validering og klinisk implementering af AI-systemer inden for radiologi
jobs.description:
The Department of Clinical Medicine at the Faculty of Health, Aarhus University, invites applications for a position as AI Developer for validation and clinical implementation of AI systems, commencing on 1 January 2027, preferably before then, if possible. The position is a fixed-term full-time appointment until 31 December 2028 which aligns with the end date of the project related to the grant agreement. 

AURA is the radiology research unit at Aarhus University Hospital and is affiliated with the Department of Clinical Medicine at Aarhus University. We conduct research across a broad range of radiological topics and work closely with clinical departments on projects spanning classical statistical methods, artificial intelligence, language models, and advanced image analysis.

In recent years, we have expanded our activities within AI and are therefore seeking additional expertise for both existing and new projects. As an AI Developer in AURA, you will play a central role in validating, implementing, and further developing AI solutions for use in healthcare. You will become part of an ambitious research environment with close collaboration between researchers, clinicians, and technical specialists, and you will have the opportunity to influence both projects and your own role.

As an AI Developer at the Department of Clinical Medicine, you will become part of what is likely the largest health sciences research institute in Denmark. Clinical research covers all medical specialties and is carried out in close collaboration with the university hospital and regional hospitals in the Central Denmark Region. We have approximately 30,000 square metres of modern research facilities for experimental surgery and medicine, animal facilities, and advanced scanners. The department has overall responsibility for the Master’s degree programmes in Medicine and Molecular Medicine. The department comprises approximately 670 academic staff members, 500 PhD students, and 160 technical and administrative staff, all working collaboratively across disciplines. As an AI Developer, you will be based at Aarhus University Hospital in the Central Denmark Region. You can read more about the department here and about the faculty here.

Your Job Responsibilities
As an AI Developer, your primary responsibilities will be to develop, validate, and implement AI solutions for clinical use, while supporting the research group's activities within data analysis, software development, and advanced image analysis. You will contribute to research and development activities through technical development, project work, and interdisciplinary collaboration. In your daily work, you will collaborate closely with researchers, clinicians, students, and external partners.

Your tasks will primarily include:

• Validation and implementation of AI systems for clinical use.
• Development, testing, and evaluation of new AI solutions.
• Software development and data analysis related to research and development projects.
• Establishment and maintenance of technical workflows and development environments.
• Responsibility for your own technical sub-projects and development processes.
• Providing technical and methodological support and advice to researchers and clinicians.
• Co-supervision and academic support of Master's and PhD students.
• Collaboration with external partners, including companies and healthcare stakeholders.
• Contributing to the establishment of new research and development projects within AI and radiology.
The position offers a high degree of independence, and we would like you to help shape the content of the role so that it matches your competencies, interests, and career goals.

You will report to Clinical Professor, Department Chair of Radiology, Ole Graumann.

Your Qualifications
You hold a Master's degree in a relevant field, such as computer science, software development, physics, engineering, or a related discipline.

We expect that you:

• Have strong competencies in programming and software development.
• Are familiar with Linux and command-line based work.
• Have experience with AI development or similar technical development work.
• Are able to work independently and drive technical projects and sub-projects.
• Enjoy collaborating with and supporting researchers and students in their projects.
It is an advantage if you have experience with:

• Research projects or research collaborations.
• Healthcare data, medical image analysis, or clinical AI systems.
• Supervision, teaching, or academic mentoring.
Your educational background is less important than your technical competencies, experience, and ability to translate technical solutions into practical applications within a clinical environment.

As a person, you possess strong collaborative skills, demonstrate initiative, and are able to drive progress in complex projects. You thrive in an interdisciplinary environment and contribute positively to a good working environment. We expect you to speak and write English fluently.

We Offer
• A strong and ambitious research environment with close ties to clinical practice.
• Significant influence over your own projects and responsibilities.
• The opportunity to shape the development and implementation of AI solutions in healthcare.
• The opportunity to co-supervise Master's and PhD students.
• Excellent opportunities for professional development within AI, software development, and clinical implementation.
• An interdisciplinary environment with close collaboration between researchers, clinicians, and technical specialists.
Questions About the Position
If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact MD, PhD, and External Lecturer Mathis Rasmussen by telephone at +45 23 80 42 10 or by email at mathis.rasmussen@rm.dk.

The place of work is AURA, Department of Radiology, Aarhus University Hospital, Palle Juul-Jensens Boulevard 99, DK-8200 Aarhus N, Denmark.

The application deadline is Monday the 9th of November 2026.

We expect to conduct interviews Monday the 23rd of November 2026. A second interview, if required, is expected to take place on Wednesday, 25th of November 2026. As part of the recruitment process, you may be asked to complete a short professional case assignment.

Terms of employment
Salary and terms of employment are governed by the collective agreement for Academics in the State, Nurses in the State or Nurses and radiographers with a master’s degree. Academics in the State will be appointed at basic salary grade 4–8. For the right candidate, appointment as Senior Consultant will be possible, with remuneration in accordance with Appendix 4 of the collective agreement. Nurses in the State will be appointed at basic salary grade 1-6, and Nurses and radiographers with a master’s degree will be appointed at basic salary grade 1-8.

Application
Your application must include the following:

• Motivated application
• Curriculum Vitae
• Indication of education (a copy of the diplomas should be uploaded)
• References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the recruitment system
We refer to the faculty’s Guideline for applicants.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

About the Position

KS-Service ApS (CVR 40310770) is a road freight and transport company based in Birkerød. We are looking for two reliable and motivated Drivers to join our team.

The positions are full-time and involve the safe, efficient and professional transport of goods for the company's customers. The ideal candidates have experience with transport, delivery or logistics, and are committed to excellent customer service and high safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Daily transport of goods to customers and business partners.

• 
Loading and unloading the vehicle safely and efficiently.

• 
Completing delivery and transport documentation accurately.

• 
Planning efficient routes and adapting to traffic conditions.

• 
Keeping the assigned vehicle clean and roadworthy.

• 
Communicating professionally with customers when required.

• 
Reporting vehicle defects, delays or incidents.

• 
Following Danish traffic laws and company safety procedures.

• 
Cooperating with the operations manager, colleagues and management.

Requirements

• 
Valid driving licence.

• 
Experience as a driver is an advantage.

• 
Ability to lift and handle goods safely.

• 
Good English communication skills (Danish is an advantage but not required).

• 
Reliable, punctual and service-minded.

• 
Able to work independently and take responsibility.

Working Hours

• 
Full-time employment (37 hours per week).

• 
Overtime is not expected.

Employment Terms

• 
Permanent, full-time position.

• 
Employment under Danish labour law.

• 
Holiday entitlement and sick leave according to Danish legislation.

How to Apply

Please send your CV and a short application in English to: job@vejentil.dk. Write “Driver – KS-Service” in the subject line.

Applications are reviewed continuously, and interviews will be held on an ongoing basis until both positions have been filled.

Equal Opportunity Employer

KS-Service ApS welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of nationality, gender, age, religion or ethnic background.

****Driven by a passion for business growth...

Our Mission:

Our objective is to grow revenue, profitability and positive cash flow of the standard parts business by building a competitive product portfolio to fulfill the needs of our aerospace customers. We ensure that the market is serviced in an efficient way by building long term relationships with suppliers and customers as well as building the internal business model and processes to achieve this.

**What The Job Is...

**As the Product Manager for Standard Parts, you will serve as the primary global representative for standard parts, providing strategic direction and guidance to key stakeholders.

Based in Copenhagen, this role forms an integral part of the global product management team overseeing the standard parts product line (encompassing C&E, hardware, fasteners, consumables, and raw materials). Collaborating closely across all relevant functional areas within the Satair Standard Parts network, you will actively drive business operations-leading continuous improvement efforts, gathering market intelligence, implementing business processes, and overseeing fulfillment support.

The Standard Parts Product Line is entering into a phase made of strong ramp up combined with an important challenge on our competitiveness. The Jobholder will have the great opportunity to shape and lead this role in the Customer Service organization.

Primary Responsibilities:

Product Strategy & Roadmap Execution

• Develop and execute end-to-end commodity product strategies, aligning business goals with evolving market demands and customer needs.

• Define and drive cross-functional solutions and process integrations, serving as the subject matter expert to ensure product readiness and operational excellence.

Operational Efficiency & Performance Management

• Analyze performance data to drive revenue and profitability targets; champion continuous improvement and automation efforts..

• Serve as the primary liaison between customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to resolve critical issues and optimize the end-to-end value chain.
